Theropod_Bipedal_Chassis.description: Rivaled only by the mightiest of titans, the Theropod Bipedal Chassis is a towering amalgamation of sinew and scale, its robust saurian form granting unparalleled strength and agility, making it a formidable presence on the battlefield and a conduit for the devastating Charge skill.

Sauropod_Colossal_Frame.description: Enveloped in a dense layer of bony plates and reinforced by a labyrinthine network of internal struts, the Sauropod_Colossal_Frame is a testament to sheer bulk and resilience, its massive quadrupedal form capable of withstanding the fiercest blows while its colossal strength allows it to plow through obstacles with unyielding force.

Raptor_Agile_Skeleton.description: Enveloped in a sleek, sinuous frame of interlocking bone, the Raptor_Agile_Skeleton is a marvel of natural engineering, its bipedal form boasting an elongated spine and powerful hind limbs that enable explosive leaps and swift, agile movements through even the densest underbrush.

Ankylosaur_Armored_Chassis.description: The Ankylosaur_Armored_Chassis is a ponderous yet resilient quadrupedal core, encased in a natural exoskeleton of jagged plates that deflect even the sharpest of blades, though its lumbering gait betrays the trade-off of such formidable protection.

Pterosaur_Hollow_Boned_Frame.description: Embodying the essence of aerial mastery, the Pterosaur_Hollow_Boned_Frame grants the user an unparalleled agility and evasion, enhancing their ability to navigate through the skies with grace and precision, as if born to glide and soar through the winds of a tempestuous realm.

Spinosaurus_Aquatic_Biped_Chassis.description: The Spinosaurus Aquatic Biped Chassis is a formidable construct, a marvel of dark biomechanics that melds the raw strength and agility of a bipedal saurian with the grace and power to traverse both land and water with unparalleled prowess, enhancing its bearer's might and resilience.

Ceratopsian_Quadruped_Core.description: Enveloped in gnarled plates of obsidian black armor, the Ceratopsian Quadruped Core is a testament to brute strength and resilience, its powerful limbs and thick skull granting it the raw might and tenacity needed to shrug off even the most devastating blows while it charges headlong into battle, a living fortress on the march.

Chameleon_Arboreal_Saurian_Frame.description: The Chameleon_Arboreal_Saurian_Frame is a marvel of natural engineering, blending the lithe agility of a reptilian predator with the unparalleled ability to blend into its surroundings, making it a master of both arboreal navigation and stealthy ambushes.

Mosasaur_Glimmering_Aquatic_Chassis.description: The Mosasaur Glimmering Aquatic Chassis is a sleek, serpentine core that pulsates with an ethereal light, enhancing the user's agility and speed in water, granting unmatched maneuverability and the ability to breathe effortlessly beneath the waves.

Zombie_Trex_Rotten_Chassis.description: The Zombie_Trex_Rotten_Chassis is a towering, skeletal frame of a tyrannosaurus, its thick, sinewy muscles now rotted and hanging loosely, granting it immense physical strength and resilience, though its once-mighty stride is slowed by the decay that plagues its monstrous form.
